Dialogue_Text: "The music made the air in the ballroom vibrate. At the front of the room stood he: the Maestro. He was surrounded by pairs of dancing swords, clashing against one another with passion, but also with a touch of anger. Then, they stepped into the center of the room: the uninvited guests. They manifested out of the blue. The Maestro looked at them with an amused grin."
Well, my raven, it sounds like a play I might have read before! Or... perhaps one that I might have dreamt about. 'Tis should be quite a show. Shall we step in and face this Maestro?

There's a funny story behind this one. I've got this book from someone, but... I never found out who sent it. Perhaps I was destined to find it and put it on display! Pay 3,500 gold pieces and enter the ballroom with unquestionable grace. If you have enough gold to pay the fee, that is.
I do. Here. Take it. It's been a while since I went to a dance.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
I hope you've brought your dancing shoes! Let the ball begin!
